Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
I agree with [Miss Sewell](/person/1301)as to the alteration, otherwise it will do very nicely. I hope to be at home on the 1st or 2nd of June[^2]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^2]: The book in question must have been [European History](/book/82) (1870).
